title: Fixed DXF handle membership table
scope: Continue the 7S.2c export-setup allocation audit for the fixed DXF handle membership set.
Remove per-export tree-node allocation while retaining logarithmic fixed-handle lookups.
Preserve reserved-handle collision and raw-entity refusal behavior.

changes: Replace fileExport's local std::set of 22 constant fixed handles with an immutable sorted std::array and binary_search.
Add a constexpr strict-order/uniqueness assertion so future table edits cannot silently invalidate binary_search.
Use the same membership helper for fixed-collision remapping and raw-entity reservation.

test.note: Existing generated ASCII/Binary PLOTSETTINGS graph coverage includes a fixed-handle collision and fail-closed/retry behavior.

method.kind: Source-level constant-set audit plus focused generated adapter test
method.limitations: This removes dynamic allocation for one fixed lookup table; it is not an end-to-end export benchmark or a closure of the wider 7S.2c census.
